purpose: Validate the first non-TL-UL seed can run conservative batched GPU launches after one-state normalized CPU/GPU equivalence passed.
preconditions: artifacts/ and reports/ are ignored generated outputs

batched_gpu_runs: dumped state byte size equals storage_size * nstates when dump is requested
no repeated-step CPU/GPU equality claim is made until a matching CPU baseline exists

non_claims: no XuanTie CPU speedup claim until a matching CPU repeated-step baseline exists
no full non-TL-UL generality claim from one E902 wrapper
this gate is a conservative launch/scaling gate, not a release boundary
